title: claude session
description: Record of claude:session:{host}:{sid} — one live Claude Code session, on the central Redis since the CD-7 relocation. Grandfathered shape (CD-3). This is a Redis HASH, not a JSON string: fields are described here as the DECODED record, and every value arrives off the wire as a string that the reader parses. Key is exactly 4 segments; {host} and {sid} both obey the host-token contract ([A-Za-z0-9._-], 1..63) and the key is authoritative for {host}. TTL 7200 s, re-armed on every lifecycle write, so an abandoned session disappears on its own. Written by the Claude Code hooks (SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop/SessionEnd, plus a throttled ts-only keepalive on every tool call); SessionEnd DELs the key. `status` and `ts` are the whole liveness contract and a record missing either is rejected outright — that is the resurrection-race guard: a statusline write landing after SessionEnd would otherwise raise a session from the dead. A keepalive refreshes `ts` alone and can never change what the record claims, so a partial hash carrying only `ts` is a legitimate transient (a session whose first full write has not landed yet) and correctly renders as nothing at all.

host.description: Echo of the key's host segment; the key is authoritative

project.description: Basename of the session's cwd, POSIX or Windows style

status.description: Published status. `blocked` means the agent is sitting on an AskUserQuestion and cannot proceed without the user. An unrecognised value distrusts the whole record rather than defaulting

ts.description: Unix seconds of the last lifecycle event or keepalive. Drives the reader's freshness ladder (fresh -> idle at 15 min -> stale at 40 min); a non-numeric value rejects the record

started_ts.description: Unix seconds of SessionStart. Absent for a session whose start predates its publisher, which renders as an unknown duration rather than a zero one

model.description: Friendly model label, e.g. "Opus 5". Read from the transcript by the hooks, since the statusline never runs for headless or desktop sessions. Absent until one is known

title.description: Claude's own session name. Lags by a few turns because Claude does not generate one immediately; an empty or absent title falls back to `project` in the view
